verdict.rationale: No evidence describes running a Windows VM (e.g., via KVM/QEMU, VirtualBox, GNOME Boxes) on Ubuntu Desktop; the only virtualization-adjacent evidence (ubuntu-docs-6, ubuntu-docs-21) is WSL, which runs Linux inside Windows — the opposite direction from the story. Dual-boot mentions (ubuntu-docs-3, ubuntu-docs-22) address running Ubuntu alongside Windows on bare metal, not virtualizing Windows inside Ubuntu.
